findings.title: get_monitor_environment_context builds a modified config copy but returns the unmodified monitor.config
findings.body: In `get_monitor_environment_context` (new file incident_occurrence.py), line 160 copies the monitor config and line 161-162 replaces `schedule_type` with its human-readable display value, but line 168 returns `monitor_environment.monitor.config` — the original, unmodified dict — instead of the local `config` variable. The local `config` is dead code and the monitor context attached to the produced occurrence event always contains the raw schedule type value. This bug was carried over from the previous location in mark_failed.py; since this PR touches and moves the function, it should be fixed by returning `config` instead.

findings.title: Public functions removed from mark_failed module with no compatibility aliases or test updates in this PR
findings.body: This PR deletes the module-level functions `mark_failed_threshold`, `create_issue_platform_occurrence`, `get_failure_reason`, `get_monitor_environment_context`, and the `SimpleCheckIn` TypedDict from `sentry/monitors/logic/mark_failed.py`, moving them to `sentry/monitors/logic/incidents.py` (renamed to `try_incident_threshold`) and `sentry/monitors/logic/incident_occurrence.py`. The changed-files list contains no test updates and no other callers were touched, so any existing tests or code that import these names from `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed` (e.g. `from sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed import mark_failed_threshold`) will now fail at import time with ImportError/AttributeError. The PR should either include the corresponding test/import updates or verify no other references to the old paths exist.
